answer_1.quote: Given input text as a prompt, the task of controlled text generation is to generate a continuation that flows naturally from the prompt while having the desired attribute ...
datasets: Jigsaw Unintended Bias in Toxicity Classification
answer_1.outputs: text continuations, rewritten sentences, sentiment‑controlled generations

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our generations for toxicity, fluency, and diversity. Toxicity is measured using the Perspective API score ... Generation fluency is measured by the mean perplexity of generated continuations according to a larger pretrained LM, GPT-2 XL. Generation diversity is measured using the mean number of distinct n‑grams ...

answer_3.quote: Generation fluency is measured by the mean perplexity of generated continuations according to a larger pretrained LM, GPT-2 XL.

answer_4.quote: We carry out a human evaluation on Amazon Mechanical Turk on 120 random prompts ... Each comparison pair is rated by three Turkers, who select which of the two continuations is: (1) less toxic, (2) more fluent, and (3) more topical ... For sentiment we also asked annotators to select which generation achieves the desired sentiment better, along with fluency and topicality questions.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators choose which of two continuations is less toxic/more fluent/more topical (toxicity task) or which better matches the desired sentiment, as well as fluency and topicality (sentiment task).
